title: Core - the Lantern shelf
notes: AZURE trade core. One dominant landmark: a lit stellar shelf high on the right, warm-hearted
inside a cool body, recognisable from a single glance at the horizon. A far, dimmer companion
upper-left gives the sky a second depth without giving it a second subject.
Construction, in the order it matters: a PLATEAU envelope (edge) so the authored ellipse only
says where material MAY be; a low-frequency billow base that owns the big lobes; a
high-frequency field that ERODES those lobes where the base is already weak, so the interior
stays solid and the rim shreds into detail; then a two-step light march toward lightAngle,
which is what puts a bright edge on the lobes facing the light and a dark canyon behind them.
The lower-left play corridor is an explicit protected void: combat and machinery keep their
headroom by construction, not by luck.

layers.comment: Outer halo: broad, high-bias, low-gain. Irregular by construction, never a smooth disc.
The Lantern body. Large torn lobes, lit from the upper left, deep canyons behind them.
Inner knot: denser and finer, so the landmark has a bright heart with its own structure.
Far companion. Smaller, cooler, softer light: a second distance, not a second subject.
Near dust crossing the shelf. Noise-broken, so it reads as dust on a path, not as ink.
Protected play corridor: lower-left stays genuinely black behind the fight.
